Dear Scarborough residents,
We want to remind you that the city of Scarborough aims to become an Avian Night
Neighborhood. This is a special 143. given to communities that are working to eliminate
unnecessary bright lighting.
You may be wondering why this initiative is 144. Many birds migrate through this area at
night, and bright lighting can interfere with their navigation.
We can all help by turning off nonessential lights from midnight to 6:00 A.M. 145. Many shops
have bright floodlights illuminating their storefronts even when they are closed. If you must
have a light on at night, you should direct it downward and away from trees where birds are
likely nesting. 146., use motion-sensor lights that are on only when absolutely needed.
Thank you!
Diane Slusky
Communications Department
City of Scarborough
